Global (All).summary: Tensions between the US and China rise over Taiwan relations.
Global food prices surge due to drought and war in Ukraine and Russia.
Protests erupt in India over new labor laws.

United States.title: US Federal Judge Blocks Biden's Student Loan Forgiveness Plan
United States.summary: On Aug 4, a federal judge ruled that President Biden's student loan forgiveness plan was unlawful, dealing a blow to the administration's efforts to address the issue.

United States.title: US Supreme Court Allows Trump's Tax Returns To Be Handed Over To Prosecutors
United States.summary: The Supreme Court has given the green light for Trump's tax returns to be handed over to Manhattan prosecutors, a major development in the investigation into the former President's finances.

United States.title: US Lawmakers Reach Deal To Avoid Potential Government Shutdown
United States.summary: After days of negotiations, US lawmakers have reached a deal to avoid a potential government shutdown, a significant development that comes as the federal budget is set to expire.

South Korea.summary: South Korea reports 14,000 more omicron cases in the last 4 days.
South Korea’s president Yoon Suk-yeol orders a probe into spy allegations against a minister amid opposition party demands.
South Korea’s government issues a public warning about North Korea’s potential missile launch after detecting activity at the Tongchon launch site.

Japan.title: Japanese government's response to COVID-19 cases sparks concerns among elderly
Japan.summary: Japan's government has faced criticism for its response to a recent surge in COVID-19 cases, with elderly citizens expressing concerns about access to vaccines and medical care.

Japan.title: Protests against nuclear power in Japan
Japan.summary: Tens of thousands of people protested in Tokyo and several other Japanese cities on August 7, demanding an end to the use of nuclear power in the country.

Japan.title: LDP's Koizumi and Fumio Kishida's speeches raise questions over Japanese government's stance on US-China relations
Japan.summary: Recent speeches by LDP's Fumio Kishida and former PM Junichiro Koizumi have led to increased speculation about Japan's stance on US-China relations, with some pundits warning of a potential shift towards a more neutral position.
